pages.text: Habilis finds fire. Erectus keeps it. Work a fire drill against the ground and you have a hearth, not a flash of flame - and a hearth burns as long as somebody feeds it.
Sticks, branches, grass, logs: right-click the hearth with them. A few minutes' fire each, and up to twenty banked. Let it run dry and it goes to ash; the drill lights it again.

Meat laid on it comes off cooked, and cooked meat goes further and makes nobody ill.$(br2)At night nothing that hunts will come into the light of a hearth you are sitting by. Spend a whole night beside one - awake or asleep - and you are the kind of animal that owns the dark.
